title: Upper-Arm Kneading
summary: The upper-arm muscle is gently compressed and released between the palm and fingers.
instructions: Place the hand on the muscular upper arm.
warning: Do not massage with acute pain, recent injury, marked swelling, inflammation, or impaired sensation.
